items: 【Bookshelf with 2 Removable Drawers】The industrial ladder bookshelf comes with 2 removable fabrics drawers,which are not only secure enough,but also provide more storage space.Drawer size is 10.83"D×13.98"W x5.31"H.

【Ample Storage】With 5 tier shelves and 2 drawers, the ladder Bookshelf has ample storage space with plenty of open space as well as secret storage. Not only can you display books on the shelves, but also plants, photos, decorations and anything else you can think of.

【Sturdy & Stable Structure】Trapezoidal frame is made of particle board and thickened metal frame, reinforced by X-shaped crossbars to ensure stability and durability.4 adjustable feet to ensure stable standing on uneven ground, and secured by anti-tip kits for great stability.

【One Bookshelf Multiple Uses】This storage shelf is suitable for study, living room, kitchen, balcony and many other scenes. It is ideal for displaying and storing pictures, plants and other household items.

【Complements Your Decor】Constructed of wood shelves and a black metal frame, this ladder rack's rustic wood creates a cozy feel, while its minimalist design blends seamlessly with a variety of home décor.

【Worry-Free Assembly】This 5 shelf bookcase overall dimension is 11.42"D x 15.35"W x 63.39"H.Marked parts and necessary tools making it very easy to assemble with the instructions and tools included in the package.We provides customer service before and after purchase.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
